verdict.rationale: Solid's own README explicitly claims full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration "to get to interactive as quickly as possible," which matches this story directly. It also lists streaming SSR and progressive hydration among its core features. The evidence is limited to short first-party marketing statements, so how hydration works and what it achieves are not shown. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the progressive hydration mechanism or API, independent or hands-on corroboration of faster time-to-interactive.
